name: create-src20
description: Create and interact with SRC20 tokens on Seismic

scripts.build: bun run build:cjs && bun run build:esm && bun run build:bin && bun run build:types
scripts.build:cjs: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist/_cjs --target browser --format cjs --packages external
scripts.build:esm: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist/_esm --target browser --format esm --packages external
scripts.build:bin: bun build src/bin.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --packages external

author: Seismic Systems
